text:
tess: big shoutout to @omar (ops) and @evie (facilities) for the midnight sprint when the sprinkler test went sideways and soaked half of conference B. they salvaged the demo gear and found a dry projector. you two = legends. :fire_extinguisher: :pray:
omar: wild night. found the sprinkler valve labelled 'test' but not 'do not open near demos'  moved soaked boxes to the staging tent and set up a drying rack. special thanks to @mira for the quick duct-tape triage. :wrench: :tshirt:
evie: facilities here  we rinsed, dried, and reboxed what we could. tagged items that need warranty claims. also put an emergency bag with chargers and HDMI cables in the kitchenette under "kudos". :label: :electric_plug:
mira: duct-tape and coffee is a legit repair strategy. also mailed a spare mic to the speaker who was remote and couldn't make it into the office. :mailbox_with_mail: :microphone:
remy: shoutout to @mail-bot for scanning the courier return and to the delivery team who stayed late to pick up the damaged boxes. mail-bot: "PACKAGE-789" logged at dock C 23:12. :robot_face: :package:
mail-bot: package_scan: "KITS-DRY-01" moved to repair bench 23:45  ETA to vendor 08:00 next day.
pantry-bot: snack_drop: "recovery-kits" placed in kitchen (label: kudos)  includes granola bars + electrolyte packets. enjoy and hydrate! :banana: :sweat_drops:
tess: added a quick kudos note to the all-hands deck and flagged the facilities + ops cross-team. leadership, these folks did the heavy lifting overnight. :heart:
omar: also a tiny PSA  if you see water around equipment, don't power it on. shoutout to @mira for remembering that. could've been worse. :eyes: :zap:
evie: follow-ups: filing warranty claims, updating the courier checklist, and adding a sprinkler-test sign for the dock. will post the doc in #office-ops. :memo: :construction:
remy: minor contest: best 'how it started / how it ended' caption wins a sticker pack. drop your captions and reactions below. :trophy:
kudos-bot: badge_awarded: "midnight-rescue" to omar, evie, mira, remy at 00:55. :medal:
tess: thanks again everyone  leave a quick emoji if you grabbed a recovery kit or helped so we can send a formal thank-you to the vendor and the courier team. :raised_hands: :tada:
